'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory Brian Harold dual-DS; sheet Brian Herold DS. Title Nick & Norah's Infinite Decklist. Do not merge with p65.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Herold]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
